study: Count five %R combination rows against the next 3 minutes. Each row is reported on its own. The earlier sessions and the later sessions are both shown.
registered_at: 2026-10-18, before any return of these rows was computed.
origin: Operator 2026-10-18: count the hook off the floor, and the other combination rows the one-line bins never separated. The profit run on those charts is the kind of push the existing trail can hold. The count is how often that run is there, and how big it is.
what_a_session_is: Every bet is intraday. The lines are read at the close of a minute, and the return is the next 3 minutes of that same session. Half A, sessions on or before 2026-07-23, is one column. Half B, sessions after 2026-07-23, is the other column. The split is which sessions are which column. It is not a daily hold.

rows.hook: First minute only. Five minutes ago the fast line was at or below -80, the fast line is now at least 5 points higher, and the slow line is still at or below -60. The lines do not have to be within 15 points. The minutes after this first minute are not the hook.
rows.square_on: First minute only. Both lines are at or above -20, the absolute gap is at most 15, and the fast line is higher than the previous minute.
rows.square_stay: The same touch as square_on, on a minute that is not the first minute of that touch.
rows.pinned: Every minute of the state. The fast line is at or above -20, the slow line is at least 20 points below the fast line, and the fast line is at least as high as it was 3 minutes ago.
rows.falling: Every minute of the state. Both lines are at or below -80, the absolute gap is at most 15, and both lines are lower than they were 5 minutes ago.
rows.overlap: A minute may sit in more than one row. Each row is counted on its own minutes.

forward: Read at the close of minute m. The return starts at the SIP open of minute m+1 and ends at the SIP close of minute m+3. The 5-minute return, ending at the SIP close of minute m+5, is printed beside it and is not a second description. A later minute is not an input.
what_is_printed: For each row and each half: days, minutes, the share of those minutes that rose, the share up more than 10 bp, the share up more than 30 bp, the day-clustered gross mean and its t, the same mean over 5 minutes, the excess versus the other minutes that day, and the excess versus the other names at that minute. 10 bp and 3 bp are subtracted in the report and labeled printed. The trail is not simulated.
description: Each row gets one description from its two gross means over 3 minutes. SAME WAY UP when both halves are above zero. SAME WAY DOWN when both halves are below zero. FLAT BOTH when both halves are zero. NOT THE SAME when the signs differ. THIN when either half has fewer than 30 days, fewer than 1000 minutes, or no mean. A missing t does not change the word. Indicator misses above 1% of sampled name-days are noted and do not blank a row. There is no PASS and no single call. A description does not change config. Picking one row to trade after reading the print is a new prereg.
data: Same warehouse and sample as the path test: 119 sessions 2026-04-28..2026-10-15, 400 names per session seeded sha256(day|prescreen-sample), names with today's IEX, today's SIP, and the previous session's IEX. The parent list is the prior day's liquid names, not today's watchlist. IEX for the lines, SIP for the return. A SIP result is not assumed to transfer to an IEX fill. Lines warmed on the previous session. The causal minute grid from the path test is reused: at most 14 flat minutes forward from a real print, no look at the next print, no overnight fill. A name is not dropped because of how many bars the finished day has. The run refuses unless n = 119, first = 2026-04-28, last = 2026-10-15, and the median split is 2026-07-23.
window: Minutes 09:36 through 15:56 ET. 09:36 is the first minute with the six minutes of history the onset uses. 15:56 is the last minute whose 3-minute return ends on the 15:59 close.
no_retuning: The five rows, the cutoffs (-80, -60, a 5-point rise, -20, a gap of 15, a gap of 20), the 3-minute return, the 10 bp and 30 bp shares, the window, the sample, and the 2026-07-23 split are fixed. A different cutoff or a sixth row is a new prereg.
command: On the mini, after a result-skeptic Mode 1 READY, and only then: scp tools/studies/pr_rows.py and tools/studies/pr_path.py to /tmp, then REPO=$PWD nice -n 19 .venv/bin/python /tmp/pr_rows.py --score. No pytest over SSH. No config edit.
